$comment: App-level SAHEL values that design-system/tokens.json (canonical, verbatim SAHEL V2) does not carry. Every entry is copied from the SAHEL V18 package — the V17 handoff, the Authentication Addendum, 03-tokens/motion.json, 03-tokens/non-token-colours.json or the inline styles of 05-boards/source — never invented. tokens.json always wins: nothing here may redefine a name it already has. Consumed by scripts/build-tokens.mjs and design-system/tailwind-preset.ts.

color.$comment: Board colours that are not SAHEL V2 tokens yet (03-tokens/non-token-colours.json). The README lists them as 'confirm in SAHEL V2 or map to tokens'; they ship exactly as drawn until design answers. Remove an entry once tokens.json gains it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber warning dot and ring, payment-wait and 'now' stage (CommerceStates, ConfirmD, NavBoard). Pending design confirmation.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Success tint behind ok text and the done-stage check (CommerceStates, OrdersD, AuthStates). Pending design confirmation.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Label on blue and ok buttons (ShutterLoading, every commerce board). Pending design confirmation.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of blue actions (.add:hover on Home, PLP, PDP, commerce boards).

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the Sahel-blue campaign gradient (Home hero, auth panel).

tokens.name: blue-dark
tokens.usage: Dark end of the Sahel-blue campaign gradient (Home hero, auth panel).

tokens.name: saffron-light
tokens.usage: Highlight of the Shina sun orb (FloatingNav, Home assistant entry).

typeMobile.$comment: Mobile sizes stated in tokens.json usage notes (display-hero 'mobile 44/46', display-1 'mobile 32/36', display-2 'mobile 24/30'). Applied below the desktop breakpoint.

fontSize.$comment: Board type ramp: the sizes the 33 V18 boards actually set (05-boards/source inline styles), for text that is not one of the named tokens.json styles. Utility: text-<key> (text-13, text-12.5).

lineHeight.$comment: Board line-height ramp (px). Utility: leading-<key> (leading-17, leading-25).

radius.$comment: Board radius ramp for radii the boards set besides the tokens.json radii (image 12, input 14, card 20, sheet 28, pill): 4 and 6 (tags, swatches), 8 and 10 (thumbnails), 16 (toast, list rows), 22 and 24 (panels, mobile campaign fields), 32. Utility: rounded-<key>.

size.$comment: Control and chrome sizes from the handoff and boards. control-s 44 (minimum tap target, chips, small buttons), control-m 48, control-search 50 (header search), control-l 56 (primary CTAs, inputs). header-m 56 (mobile header), nav-h 68 (FloatingNav), nav-item 56. otp-* are the code cells (Addendum: mobile 50×60, desktop 60×68).

spacing.$comment: Half steps the boards use between Tailwind's 4px spacing steps: 7 (status dot), 18 (button padding s), 22 (button padding m/l), 26, 30. 52 (auth panel padding), 72 (eyebrow rule). Utility: p-4.5, px-5.5… Also 50/54/60/70 (sheet CTA, card footer heights, sheet thumbnail).

shadow.$comment: Board shadows that are not elevation tokens: the FloatingNav capsule, the blue button's inset highlight, and the inset outlines the boards draw instead of borders (light buttons 1.5px night, controls and chips 1px line-2, success 1.5px ok, hairline cards 1px line).

motion.$comment: 03-tokens/motion.json (SAHEL V2 README §Motion). Role names fast/base/slow are the package's suggestion.

breakpoints.$comment: SAHEL V2 defines 360 / 768 / 1280; the boards draw 390 and 1440 only and the desktop switch is an open question in the handoff. Engineering decision (V18 build): mobile layout below 1024px, desktop layout from 1024px (lg). sm 360, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280.

zIndex.$comment: Stacking order for sticky and floating chrome.
